backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profiles, coaching system (topics, goals, sessions, availability), and access control with role-based permissions for admin and user operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the implementation of a prominent 'Start Coaching Session' button in the CoachingDashboard component with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of frontend files describing React components, hooks, pages, and configuration for the AI coaching application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with title 'AI Coach Voice - Your 24/7 Personal Coach' and meta description for the coaching application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home and coaching session pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider with shared Layout component.
frontend/src/components/AvailabilityIndi: Badge component displaying 24/7 availability status with animated pulse indicator, fetching availability data via useGetAvailability hook.
frontend/src/components/CoachingDashboar: Main dashboard with hero section containing prominent 'Start Coaching Session' button, followed by quick-start topic cards and recent session history sections.
frontend/src/components/CoachingInput.ts: Combined input component with text field, send button, and voice recorder toggle for submitting messages or voice recordings in coaching sessions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright year and attribution link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/GoalCard.tsx: Card component displaying individual goal with topic, progress bar, completion percentage, and remove button using useRemoveGoal mutation.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with AI Coach Voice branding, availability indicator, navigation controls, theme toggle, and login/logout functionality using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.ts: Displays a chat message bubble with avatar, content, and optional timestamp. Supports both coach and user messages with different styling and alignment.
frontend/src/components/QuickStartCard.t: Card component that allows users to start a coaching session on a specific topic. Handles session creation and navigation with loading states.
frontend/src/components/SessionCard.tsx: Simple card component that displays a coaching session with an icon and session name.
frontend/src/components/VoiceRecorder.ts: Voice recording component with controls for recording, playing, pausing, and deleting audio. Displays recording duration and provides callback for completed recordings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that manages the backend actor instance with authentication. Handles actor creation with identity and invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication. Manages login state, identity persistence, and provides login/logout functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend API calls including availability, coaching topics, session history, goals management, and session operations. Handles mutations with toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useVoiceRecording.ts: Custom hook for managing voice recording state and operations. Handles microphone access, recording, playback, and audio blob management with duration tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for theming (light/dark modes) and custom animations for pulse-ring and slide-up effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/CoachingSessionPage.t: Main coaching session page component that displays a chat interface with message bubbles, voice input support, goal tracking cards, and simulated AI coach responses for a specific coaching topic.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page that shows a hero section with features (24/7 availability, voice enabled, goal tracking) and login button for unauthenticated users, or displays the CoachingDashboard for authenticated users.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, custom shadows, and keyframe animations for the UI components.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting the transformation from a course/tool management system to a 24/7 AI coaching application, listing implemented features like voice recording, coaching dashboard, and pending feature requests.
